controller.mapping_summary: PSP retropad profile maps the PSP d-pad, face buttons, shoulder buttons, Start/Select and analog stick to PPSSPP's libretro ports.

firmware.notes: The core-info note also requires the PPSSPP assets, lang folder and flash0 folder under system/PPSSPP; no additional canonical hashes are published in this record.

saves.naming: RetroArch PPSSPP savefiles use the content basename under the frontend save directory; PSP savedata itself is represented by PPSSPP's PSP directory tree.
saves.notes: The core uses PSP-compatible savedata and emulator persistent files.
